name: Panel
usage: Wrapping a table or a list; a standalone block of content on a page; one side of a split view

props.name: title
props.description: Panel title; without it, the panel has no title row.

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions on the right of the title.

props.name: flush
props.description: Flush content (tables, lists, trees) without padding.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding step of the content (ignored with `flush`).

props.name: fill
props.description: Fills the remaining height of the parent; the content scrolls inside the panel.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: A panel with a title and actions.

examples.name: Flush
examples.title: Flush content
examples.description: Use `flush` for tables and lists inside a panel, so that the content reaches the edges.
